hooks.text: 竞技场会持续变形，随机战利品迫使玩家临场利用所得装备撑过敌潮并击败最终食人魔
hooks.excerpt: These transforming arenas are filled with ROGUELIKE -style RANDOMIZED LOOT, where you're forced to make the most out of what you find. Waves of enemies will keep coming for you, despite how strong your gun is. SURVIVE long enough and eventually overcome the final OGRE !
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 枪芯、射击模组与升级需要动态取舍，同时还要精通飞船机动躲避复杂弹幕
hooks.excerpt: Make smart decisions about when to swap out your gun core for a new one, which shot modules to install and what upgrades to choose. Good decisions aren't enough to quarantee success, as you will also need to know how to maneuver your spaceship to dodge the complicated enemy attack patterns!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 每日无尽挑战让所有玩家使用相同初始配置，硬核模式则用分数倍率冲击高分
hooks.excerpt: Endless Dailies Game Mode , an everyday changing challenge, where every player starts with the same loadout! Hardcore Game Mode , where skilled players can get massive highscores by racking up a huge score multiplier!
